The M15 pullback has only reached 2648.28, still above the spike bar 112 open 2642.9, so the breakout point has not been lost and the pattern can still be read as a bull flag that resumes upward.
Bar 119 is the first reversal bar after a strong bull spike and has no follow-through bar yet, so the bear break of the 2673-2695 pause is unconfirmed.
uncertainty: Whether the second 2700 test is D1 breakout acceptance in progress or the second failure of the H4 range top; the D1 and H4 contexts disagree on this and both are current.
Whether 2642.9 (M15 spike bar open / H4 breakout point) will hold as support, keeping the move a bull flag rather than a reversal.

conditions_that_change_market_read: A close above 2700 (M15 bar 113 high) or two consecutive closes above 2658.79 would shift the read to H4 bull acceptance and cancel the short thesis.
A bull bar closing above bar 119 high 2682.68 without first taking out 2648.28 would mark a bear trap and argue for buying the breakout pullback instead.
Two consecutive M15 closes below 2642.9 and then below the H4 pullback low 2568.16 would confirm the failed breakout and open the 2530/2469 range-middle area for the short.
Repeated closes between 2557.46 and 2700 with no upside progress would keep the H4 range intact and preserve the sell-the-top read.
